updated_records.title_en: NATO EOD/MILENG — public Czech standardization crosswalk for AJP-3.12 / ATP-3.12.1 / ATP-3.18.1 / AEODP-10
updated_records.summary_cs: Oficiální český registr obranné standardizace veřejně uvádí klíčové MILENG/EOD standardizační vazby. Nově přímo ověřený výňatek AAP-15 z NATOTerm datovaný 15. 4. 2026 uvádí EOC jako „explosive ordnance clearance“, s referencí [AJP-3.18 Edition B Version 1] a statusem NATO Agreed k 20. 5. 2025. Tím je veřejný terminologický/normativní baseline EOC zpřesněn. Samostatný EOC annex a další standard/study-draft popsaný 69. EOD WG však z veřejného zdroje stále nelze přesně identifikovat.
updated_records.summary_en: The official Czech defence-standardization register publicly exposes key MILENG/EOD standardization links. A directly re-verified AAP-15 extract from NATOTerm dated 15 April 2026 lists EOC as “explosive ordnance clearance”, references [AJP-3.18 Edition B Version 1], and records NATO Agreed dated 20 May 2025. This sharpens the public EOC terminology/normative baseline. However, the separate EOC annex and additional standard/study draft described by the 69th EOD WG still cannot be precisely identified from the public source.
updated_records.intelligence_gaps_cs: Zjistit přesný parent standard EOC annexu a identifikátor samostatného study-draftu schváleného 69. EOD WG; NATOTerm snapshot potvrzuje AJP-3.18(B)(1) jako veřejnou referenci termínu EOC, ale tyto nové pracovní produkty nejmenuje.
updated_records.intelligence_gaps_en: Identify the exact parent standard for the EOC annex and the identifier of the separate study draft approved by the 69th EOD WG; the NATOTerm snapshot confirms AJP-3.18(B)(1) as the public EOC term reference but does not name those newer work products.

sources.title: Terminology extracted from NATOTerm — AAP-15 extract (15 April 2026)
sources.publisher: NATO Terminology Office / Czech Defence Standardization Office
sources.url_validation_basis: Direct official PDF text: cover date 2026-04-15; EOC entry on PDF page 165/parsed page 164 states explosive ordnance clearance, [AJP-3.18 Edition B Version 1], NATO Agreed 2025-05-20. Mandatory screenshot attempt failed with cache miss; no pixel-level claim is made.

evidence.what_it_supports_cs: Výňatek AAP-15 z NATOTerm datovaný 15. 4. 2026 uvádí zkratku EOC jako „explosive ordnance clearance“, odkazuje na AJP-3.18 Edition B Version 1 a uvádí stav NATO Agreed s datem 20. 5. 2025.
evidence.what_it_supports_en: The AAP-15 extract from NATOTerm dated 15 April 2026 lists EOC as “explosive ordnance clearance”, references AJP-3.18 Edition B Version 1, and records NATO Agreed dated 20 May 2025.
evidence.what_it_does_not_prove_cs: Neidentifikuje samostatný EOC annex ani study-draft zmiňovaný 69. EOD WG, neprokazuje stav po 15. 4. 2026 a nenahrazuje plný text AJP-3.18.
evidence.what_it_does_not_prove_en: It does not identify the separate EOC annex or study draft mentioned by the 69th EOD WG, does not establish status after 15 April 2026, and does not replace the full text of AJP-3.18.
